categories.main_business_segments: Meiloon Industrial Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the design, manufacturing, and sales of audio equipment including speakers, soundbars, home theater systems, professional audio products, car audio systems, and smart interactive audio devices. The company also engages in the production of electronic components and peripherals, as well as investment activities related to its core business.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced acoustic design, digital signal processing (DSP), wireless transmission technologies (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Multi-Room Audio), Power over Ethernet (PoE), and network audio transmission systems like Dante. Manufacturing integrates modular platform development, automated production lines with RFID and vision sensors, and strict quality control to ensure high yield and product stability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Meiloon serves international brand customers in consumer electronics, automotive audio, commercial and professional audio markets, including smart building solutions. Key end markets include home entertainment, commercial spaces, automotive OEMs, and smart home/IoT applications, with customers primarily in the Americas, Europe, and Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing and R&D facilities in Taiwan, China, and Indonesia, with Indonesia serving as the main mass production base. Sales are global, with significant revenue from the Americas (30.33%), Europe (39.83%), and Asia (27.20%). The company also actively expands into Southeast Asia, Middle East, and South America markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Meiloon functions as a midstream ODM/contract manufacturer with vertical integration capabilities, linking upstream raw materials and components suppliers to downstream brand customers. It manages a flexible global supply chain with multi-regional production to mitigate geopolitical and tariff risks.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on innovation in smart audio, AI integration, PoE smart building solutions, and acoustic system integration. R&D priorities include high-performance streaming audio, low-latency wireless transmission, modular platform development, and integration of AI and IoT technologies. Sustainability and ESG compliance are also key strategic pillars.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of audio equipment and electronic components. The company also benefits from ODM/contract manufacturing services, with a focus on customized design and integration solutions for global brand customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Meiloon competes in the global audio and acoustic industry against other ODM manufacturers and integrated solution providers. It differentiates itself through high vertical integration, modular design platforms, multi-regional manufacturing flexibility, and strong R&D capabilities, maintaining a leading position in the professional and consumer audio markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Meiloon reported net operating revenue of approximately NT$2.64 billion, a 13.2% increase from the previous year, and a net profit after tax of NT$232.6 million, an 811.8% growth. The company shows a stable growth trajectory supported by expanding overseas orders and improved cost control, with total assets exceeding NT$8.29 billion and equity attributable to owners of NT$4.37 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Meiloon emphasizes high-quality acoustic performance, rapid product development cycles, and flexible manufacturing through its integrated Taiwan R&D, China NPI, and Indonesia mass production model. Its modular and customizable audio solutions, combined with advanced wireless and AI technologies, provide differentiated value to customers seeking innovative, reliable, and scalable audio products.
